statement: A 2026 JPC Letters perspective argues that biomolecular recognition requires thermodynamic and kinetic observables from high-dimensional ensembles; physics-based methods provide statistical-mechanical consistency but are costly, while ML is fast but does not inherently enforce a partition-function-consistent ensemble, motivating scalable hybrid approaches.
locator: Abstract; Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters 17 (2026)
notes: Mechanistic rationale for hybrid ML/physics prioritization.
